entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order for a VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. I'd like to start a return for it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's really just a preference. The device works as advertised, but it's not as comfortable on my wrist as I had hoped. I'd just like to send it back for a refund.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up your account. I see the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th, about 26 days ago. I'll just need to check the return window for this specific product.
Okay, I appreciate that. I wasn't sure what the exact timeframe was. If it's outside the main window, would a partial store credit or a discount on a future purchase be an option?
Let me check the official policy first. For wearable devices like this, we have to be careful for hygiene and sanitation reasons once the package is opened. Let me see what the system says...
Alright, I've got it here. I'm looking at the general VeloFit return policy, and it looks like you're well within the window. All items are eligible for return within 90 days.
Oh, 90 days? That's great news. So it's not too late then?
Not at all. Since you're only on day 26, we can absolutely process a full refund for you. No problem.
That's fantastic, thank you so much. I was worried I had missed the cut-off.

You're very welcome. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account right now. Just pack everything back in the original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Your refund will be processed once it's received at our warehouse.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thanks for your help, David.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
